description: This file appears to be a Perl script for managing and generating package metadata for a software build system. It includes functions for version comparison, dependency resolution, package configuration generation, and output of package data in various formats such as JSON and CycloneDX SBOM. It also provides command-line options to invoke these functions, indicating its role as a utility script to support package management tasks within a larger project.
